correctness.rationale: (P2)+MP force A∩(A→B)=A∩B. (P3)+(P4) give dependence only on T=A∩B; (P4) forces monotone σ_A:P(A)→P(X\A), and (P5) is equivalent, for all D⊆A and T⊆D, to σ_A(T∪(A∩σ_D(T)))⊆σ_D(T)\A. Every operation satisfying these is thus included; each choice is finite. Independently compiled enumerator traversed all 1,259,712 monotone row families and found 19,127 operations, with strata (864,509,509,843,509,843,843,14207), S3 fixed counts 19127,341,341,32,32,341, and Burnside quotient 3,369; an independent direct-axioms checker source was inspected. The symbolic normal form, not a finite extrapolation, covers arbitrary finite X.

originality.rationale: Holliday defines the axioms and MP; Chen concerns semantics and proof theory. The full published 1,235-operation eight-element result adds conditional identity and consequent meet preservation; the 1,021-operation F-preconditional census instead adds different F laws and is not this MP-only class. Neither count determines 19,127 or the general σ-compatibility normal form. Targeted semantic and published-result searches found no prior full theorem; originality is best of knowledge.
